sub_topics.name: Introduction to the Video
sub_topics.description: Welcome to this proof-of-concept video. The goal today is to tack on one brilliant little idea to the Euclidean algorithm, to turn it from an algorithm that computes the greatest common divisor into an algorithm that solves linear diaphanian equations, finds modular inverses, performs the Chinese remainder theorem, and much more.

sub_topics.name: Introduction to the Extended Euclidean Algorithm
sub_topics.description: The point of the extended Euclidean algorithm is to capture the process, not just the result. So the extended Euclidean algorithm is exactly the Euclidean one, but plus a little bookkeeping along the way that lets it end up with more information.
